Usage rights

Definition

Usage rights is the defined media, territories, duration and contexts in which licensed material may be used. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align rights decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
